content.text: A highly contagious skin infection due to the mite
burrow into the skin to lay eggs, feed, & defecate
(scybala are the fecal particles that precipitate a hypersensitivity reaction in the skin)
Infected pts may remain w/o sxs for up to 4-6wks
between the fingers & toes; usually spares neck & face
red itchy pruritic papules or nodules on the scrotum, glans, penile shaft, or body folds
: mites, eggs, feces seen w/ magnification
use after showers (causes seizures d/t increased absorption through open pores)
, not usually used in breastfeeding & children <2yrs
All clothing, bedding, etc. should be placed in a plastic bag at least 72hrs then washed & dried using heat
Topical permethrin or pyrethrins first line
: person to person; fomites (hats, headsets, clothing, bedding)
Outbreaks commonly affect children 3-12yrs, warmer & humid weather
•visualization of crawling nymphs or adult lice; presence of nits alone does NOT confirm infection
white, oval-shaped egg capsules at the base of the hair shafts
fine tooth comb to remove nits
